summaries.zh: LAN access for DeepSeek Harness Web UI: loopback-preserving reverse proxy with Host/Origin rewrite, in-app browse directory picker, and a secure-context UUID polyfill. For trusted LANs only — the harness web control plane has no authentication.
summaries.en: LAN access for DeepSeek Harness Web UI: loopback-preserving reverse proxy with Host/Origin rewrite, in-app browse directory picker, and a secure-context UUID polyfill. For trusted LANs only — the harness web control plane has no authentication.
